entries.settingsVoice.byoDescription: Use your own ElevenLabs agent instead of the Happy default. No subscription required — connect directly with your own ElevenLabs account. Your agent must define two client tools: sendMessageToSession (sends text to the coding agent) and processPermissionRequest (allows or denies tool use). It receives session context via the {{initialConversationContext}} dynamic variable.
entries.settingsVoice.customAgentIdDescription: Enter your ElevenLabs agent ID. Leave empty to use the Happy default.
entries.settingsVoice.bypassTokenSubtitle: Skip Happy server, connect straight to ElevenLabs
entries.settingsVoice.promptGuideDescription:
Your ElevenLabs agent needs:

• Tool: sendMessageToSession — parameters: sessionId (string), message (string). Sends a message to the specified coding session.
• Tool: processPermissionRequest — parameters: requestId (string), decision ("allow" or "deny"). Approves or denies a pending tool permission.
• Dynamic variable: {{initialConversationContext}} — receives session history and context on start.

The agent acts as a voice bridge between the user and coding agents. It should be concise, only respond when addressed, and report when a coding agent finishes work.
